title: Carbon footprint of alternative protein sources for Atlantic salmon (Salmo salar) aquaculture: A two-step systematic literature review
study_system: Atlantic salmon aquaculture / aquaculture feed-production system
geography: Not a single study location; international literature/system-level analysis
study_objective: To identify potential alternative protein sources for Atlantic salmon aquaculture and assess their carbon footprint.
temporal_scope: Literature published 2015–2024 for the first review; second review assessed carbon footprint literature identified subsequently.
focal_factor: alternative protein sources for aquaculture feed
comparison: Explicit comparison of alternative protein sources and their carbon-footprint performance
evidence_passage: The paper states that the first systematic review identified potential alternative protein sources for Atlantic salmon aquaculture and the second assessed the environmental performance of the identified ingredients using carbon footprint as an indicator.
